title: A record in a model repository's registry
description: DRAFT 0.1.0-draft.9, 2026-11-20. Every file of a run's folder, harness/runs.registry/<stamp>_<experiment>/: the build records, which are the core schema's (execution-record.schema.json, destined for REMARK), and the execution records, which are the core's with a model repository's fields under the namespace sce-wg-1, defined here and nowhere in the core. A job of an adapter on contract 1, which writes the results file itself, has one record, <toolkit>_<member>_<level>.json. A job of an adapter on contract 2 has two: its solve, <toolkit>_<member>_<level>.json, the adapter writing the solution, method and settings files in the toolkit's environment; and its measure, <toolkit>_<member>_<level>_measure.json, the model's bench writing the results file from them in the harness's environment, outside the toolkit's container. One schema covers the whole folder, dispatching on `kind`. Draft 9 adds the step, the contract, the suggestions' and the solution's hashes, the measure step's inputs and its bench; a record of draft 8 is unchanged under it but for its `$schema`.

SceWg1.description: A model repository's fields for one job of the harness, or one step of it: which toolkit solved which member at which level, and what the organizer's gate said.

toolkit.description: The toolkit's name as harness/toolkits.yaml spells it.

entry_kind.description: The entry's kind as the registry file states it: exact, evaluated from a closed form, or numerical, approximated by a method with settings; numerical when the registry file states none.

mode.description: The mode of solution, when a toolkit has more than one, such as indshock or markov; proposed with the results schema's mode string.

code_sha256.description: The hash of the adapter's code and the modules it imports, as the runner's fingerprint computes it.

hash.description: The member's canonical hash, which identifies the model.

level.description: The experiment's level name; the adapter's own argument is in the record's arguments.

step.description: Which part of a job the record is of. job, the default: the whole job of an adapter on contract 1, which writes the results file itself. solve: the adapter on contract 2, in the toolkit's environment, writing the solution, method and settings files. measure: the model's bench, in the harness's environment and outside the toolkit's container, writing the results file from the solve's files.

contract.description: The adapter's contract as the registry file states it; 1 when it states none.

suggestions_sha256.description: Under contract 2, the canonical hash of the suggestions file the adapter was given: the level's suggestions as the experiment states them, which a toolkit may take, adapt or decline.

solution_sha256.description: Under contract 2, the hash of the solution file the adapter wrote.

toolkit_version.description: As the results file reports it, with its commit when it has one.

comparison.description: The job's comparison with its member's reference, as the comparator wrote it: reported, never judged, since a distance from the reference carries no verdict; only the experiment's checks pass or fail.

status.description: computed: every named distance computed; not run: the member pins no reference, or the job wrote no results file; error: the member pins a reference and the comparison could not be computed, the reference not loading, not answering the same question by the model's identity keys, or a quantity not comparable. An error fails the compare command; a distance never does.

reference.description: The reference results file's hash, as the experiment pins it.

report.description: The comparator's report for the job, relative to the record: every distance with the reference's error beside it.

metric.description: The metric's name: one of the core's three, or one the experiment defines.

floor.description: Under max_relative_to_reference, the floor the distance was taken with.

reference_error.description: The reference's own certified error for that quantity under that metric, when the experiment states one.

reason.description: Why the comparison was not run or is in error.

core_version.description: The version of the checker, runner and comparator that gated the run.

inputs.description: A measure step's inputs: the solve's files and the bench's settings file, each with its hash.

bench.description: A measure step's bench: the model's script, the hash of its code as the runner's fingerprint computes it, and the canonical hash of the settings the experiment gives it at the level.
